species: Muonic hydrogen (mu- p): 2S-2P Lamb shift theory and the proton radius
citation: R. Pohl, R. Gilman, G. A. Miller, K. Pachucki, Muonic hydrogen and the proton radius puzzle, Annu. Rev. Nucl. Part. Sci. 63, 175 (2013), arXiv:1301.0905, Sect. 4.2 and Sect. 1
note: Delta E_LS(r_p) = constant - r2_coefficient * r_p^2 + two_photon_exchange, r_p in fm. The constant gathers every QED term that does not depend on r_p; it is published theory, transcribed, not computed here.
